title: Base change of the transpose of a unit-valued trace
statement:
Use the finite coefficient conventions [def-pur-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. All schemes below are separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the small pro-etale derived categories and the derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the compact-support functors [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and their constructible exceptional adjoints [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Write $\otimes$ for $\otimes_A^L$.

Let $f:V\to S$ be separated finite type and let $b:S'\to S$ be a $k$-morphism. Form $V'=V\times_SS'$ with projections $a:V'\to V$ and $f':V'\to S'$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Put $\omega_f=Rf^!A_S$ and $\omega_{f'}=Rf'^!A_{S'}$. For bounded constructible inputs use the exchange isomorphism $C_M:Lb^*Rf_!M\to Rf'_!La^*M$ of [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale] and the actual exceptional Hom bijections [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]. Let $B:La^*\omega_f\to\omega_{f'}$ be the transpose of $Lb^*\varepsilon_{f,A_S}\circ C_{\omega_f}^{-1}$, followed by $Lb^*A_S\cong A_{S'}$, with the dualizing base-change convention of [def-pur-co-smoothness].

Let $L\in D^b_c(V,A)$ and $t:Rf_!L\to A_S$, and let $P:L\to\omega_f$ be its adjoint transpose. Suppose $t':Rf'_!La^*L\to A_{S'}$ satisfies $t'\circ C_L=Lb^*t$, with the unit comparison understood. Then its transpose is
$$P'=B\circ La^*P.$$
No smoothness or choice of an identification of either dualizing object with a Tate twist is assumed.

proof.text: Work in the etale representative K already retained in the statement. The definition purityTraceTranspose is comparison pullback of the actual etale homEquiv, conjugated by e.inv. The definition purityTraceDualizingBaseChange uses the same etale dualizingComplexBaseChangeMap. Thus no existence theorem for a pro-etale adjoint or a coefficient system is needed.

source.place: Definitions purityTraceTranspose and purityTraceDualizingBaseChange, in the canonical comparison coordinates of the statement.

proof.text: Let Ex be Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap P.Coefficient sq. It is invertible by the already proved source-library theorem Etale.isIso_rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap (WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/Derived/Exchange.lean). Its finite-ring hypothesis follows from comparedCoefficientFinite. Precompose the trace equation by inv (Ex.app K) and cancel, obtaining t-prime = (inv Ex).app K followed by pullback of t and the unit comparison.

source.place: isIso_rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap, and cancellation with the inverse component.

proof.text: Use the elementary general identity proved by the private helper trace_mate: for adjunctions L1 left adjoint R1 and L2 left adjoint R2, a square alpha: G L2 -> L1 H, t: L1 K -> N and u: H N -> N-prime, the transpose of alpha_K followed by H(t) and u equals G(transpose(t)) followed by mate(alpha)_N and R2(u). Expand homEquiv as unit followed by mapped morphism. Naturality of mate(alpha) at t moves R2(H(t)) past the mate, and Mathlib unit_mateEquiv [lem-pur-mate-unit-compatibility] replaces the remaining unit-mate composite. Apply this identity with alpha = inv Ex. By definition, the resulting mate at the coefficient unit followed by R2 of the unit comparison is precisely dualizingComplexBaseChangeMap. Substitute the trace equation from the preceding step.

source.place: unit_mateEquiv and mateEquiv; Adjunction.homEquiv_unit from Adjunction/Basic.lean.

proof.text: Apply comparison pullback to the etale equality. Unfold the three trace definitions and the retained pullback-origin isomorphism. Functoriality expands the inverse-origin conjugation as pullback(e.inv) followed by purityTracePullbackComparison.hom.app K. Naturality of that comparison at the etale transpose moves its component past the mapped transpose, giving exactly the claimed equation. This never inverts the dualizing base-change morphism, and uses no ambient pro-etale adjunction or Tate identification.

source.place: purityTracePullbackComparison, purityTracePullbackOrigin, and naturality of the comparison isomorphism.
